name: INOVAMusic library
notes: The library identifies INOVAMusic Library 3.1 (8 June 1993), Carl W. Moore.

The preserved GP Software Directory Opus 5.5 install bundle supplies the exact stock library through its nested Core.lha. The preserved INOVAtronics Directory Opus 4.10 disk independently carries the same bytes.
Directory Opus references inovamusic.library. This package independently owns the shared Libs/inovamusic.library and preserves its stock protection and comment.
